traits.label: Overview
traits.text: Remarkable mushroom due to its decurrent, bright yellow pores which undergo a color change to blue-grey when bruised. It holds a close taxonomic relation to the genus Paxillus. Its primary habitat is in Europe, forming a symbiotic mycorrhizal association with alders, although reports also indicate its presence in regions such as China, Japan, and California. Notably different from the typical boletes, this mushroom stands out both for its unique association with alder and its distinct pore coloration.

🔤 Remarkable mushroom due to its decurrent, bright yellow pores which undergo a color change to blue-grey when bruised. It holds a close taxonomic relation to the genus Paxillus. Its primary habitat is in Europe, forming a symbiotic mycorrhizal association with alders, although reports also indicate its presence in regions such as China, Japan, and California. Notably different from the typical boletes, this mushroom stands out both for its unique association with alder and its distinct pore coloration.
